g.text: Average indirect effect (ACME) on CVD risk (95% CI)
41 LE8 BH-FDR-negative candidates; average ACME with 95% CI; ACME P values re-adjusted by BH-FDR
Exploratory mediation analysis: Pollutant -> LE8 -> CVD
Mediation percentages are shown only for FDR-significant, consistent mediation with estimates between 0% and 100%.
